en.title: {name} — Websites for small businesses across Australia
en.description: A web studio for Australian small businesses and sole traders. Open {count} working website demos — cafés, driving schools, trades, clinics, creatives — try your business name on them, then start a project.

hero.eyebrow: Web studio for small businesses · Australia
hero.lede: Open any drawer and step inside. Each one is a working website we designed and built by hand — for cafés, driving schools, tradies, clinics, creatives and more. Find the feel that fits your business, then let's make yours.
hero.tryon_hint: Your name appears on every demo you open. It stays in your browser — nothing is sent.
hero.tryon_done: Done — open any drawer to see “{brand}” on it.
hero.tryon_cleared: Name cleared — demos show their own names again.
hero.box_label: A preview wall of all {count} demos

proof.label: The box, measured
proof.stock: stock photos — every visual is drawn in code

box.title: Open a drawer.
box.intro: Each drawer holds a complete little website for a made-up business. Filter by your industry, a mood you like or a feature you need — then step inside and use it.
box.note: Concepts for fictional businesses. Names, prices and details inside are illustrative.
box.empty_body: Try fewer filters — or let the box choose for you.

services.title: Built around how small businesses actually run.
services.intro: No jargon, no bloated packages. We start with what your customers need to do — book, order, call, find you — and build around that.

items.title: One-page sites
items.body: For sole traders and new ventures. Everything a customer needs on one fast page: what you do, where, when, and how to reach you.

items.title: Small business websites
items.body: A handful of well-made pages — services, prices, gallery, about, contact. Clear for first-time visitors, easy to keep up to date.

items.title: Bookings & enquiries
items.body: Lesson slots, appointments, tables and quotes. We connect a booking tool you trust, or build a simple enquiry flow that lands in your inbox.

items.title: Menus, ordering & small shops
items.body: Menus that are easy to change, order-ahead and small product ranges — connected to proven platforms rather than home-made checkouts.

items.title: Bilingual sites · 双语网站
items.body: English and Chinese side by side, each written for its readers rather than machine-translated. Right-to-left languages too.
items.good: Businesses serving more than one community

items.title: Care after launch
items.body: Domain and hosting set up in your name, small updates when you need them, and a plain-English guide for changing the basics yourself.
items.good: Everyone who'd rather be running their business

services.more: Explore all services — websites, apps & business tools

process.title: From a chat to a live site in four steps.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.body: A short call, email or WeChat. What you do, who your customers are, and what you want them to do on your site.

steps.title: Pick a few drawers
steps.body: Save the demos that feel right. It's the fastest way to show us your taste — no design vocabulary needed.

steps.title: See it, shape it
steps.body: We design with your real words and photos, then share a working preview you can click through on your phone. You tell us what to change.

steps.title: Launch & look after
steps.body: We set up your domain and hosting in your name, test on real devices, and show you how to make simple updates.

process.note: Timelines and pricing depend on scope — you'll get a written quote before any work starts.

items.title: Designed for phones first
items.body: Most customers will find you on a phone. Every layout is designed for small screens, not squeezed onto them.

items.title: Fast by default
items.body: Hand-written code, no page-builder bloat. The average demo in this box weighs {avg_kb} KB.

items.title: Easy to read, easy to use
items.body: Readable contrast, keyboard access and a sensible structure — the basics of accessibility, built in.

items.title: Ready for search
items.body: Proper titles, descriptions and page structure so search engines understand your business. Nobody can promise rankings — we won't either.

items.title: Yours to keep
items.body: Your domain, hosting and words belong to you. If you ever move on, everything goes with you.

items.title: Honest by design
items.body: No fake reviews, no invented numbers. We help you show real proof — photos, credentials and customer words you have permission to use.

items.q: Are the businesses in the box real?
items.a: No. Every drawer is a concept for a made-up business, designed to show range. Names, prices, reviews and contact details inside the demos are illustrative. Your site will be built around your real business.

items.q: Can I have a site like one of the demos?
items.a: Yes — any drawer can be a starting point. We adapt the layout and style to your brand, your words and your photos, so it ends up yours rather than a copy.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: Every project is quoted to its scope and your budget. We explain the deliverables, payment stages and ongoing costs in writing before work starts. Fair pricing, with changes agreed before additional work begins.

items.q: Do I need to know anything technical?
items.a: No. We ask plain questions about your business. You bring your logo if you have one, photos, services and prices — we handle the rest.

items.q: Can I update the site myself?
items.a: If you'd like to. For businesses that change menus or prices often we set up a simple way to edit them; otherwise we can make updates for you. We'll recommend what suits you.

items.q: Do you work outside my city?
items.a: Yes. We work with businesses across Australia by phone, video call, email and WeChat.

items.q: Can you build in English and Chinese?
items.a: Yes. We write each language for its readers rather than translating word for word, and can add other languages too.

contact.title: Tell us about your business.
contact.intro: A few answers are enough. We'll turn them into a short brief you can email to us — or copy into WeChat, WhatsApp or a text.
contact.liked_empty: None yet — tap ♥ on any drawer and it will appear here.
contact.when: When would you like to launch?
contact.message_placeholder: Your customers, your favourite websites, deadlines…
contact.brief_empty: Start typing — your brief builds itself here.
contact.copied: Copied — paste it into WeChat, WhatsApp or a text.
contact.copy_failed: Couldn't copy automatically — select the brief and copy it.
contact.emailed: Your email app should now be open with the brief filled in. We receive it when you press Send.
contact.subject: Website enquiry — {business}
contact.channels_preview: Preview build: direct contact details will appear here once they're connected. You can still copy your brief.
contact.privacy: This form doesn't send or store anything on a server. Your answers stay in this page until you choose to email or copy them.

footer.tagline: Websites, apps & digital tools for small businesses.
footer.disclaimer: All demos are concept designs for fictional businesses. Names, prices, reviews and details inside them are illustrative.

zh.title: {name} — 为澳洲小生意做网站
zh.description: 面向澳洲小生意与个体经营者的网站工作室。打开 {count} 个可以真正操作的网站 demo——咖啡馆、驾校、装修、诊所、手艺人——换上你的店名试试，然后开始你的项目。

hero.eyebrow: 澳洲小生意的网站工作室
hero.title_html:
一个盒子，
装着 {count} 个网站。
hero.lede: 打开任何一个抽屉，走进去看看。每一个都是我们亲手设计、能真正上手操作的网站——咖啡馆、驾校、装修师傅、诊所、手艺人……找到最像你生意的那种感觉，然后我们为你做一个。
hero.tryon_hint: 打开任何一个 demo，都会换上你的店名。只保存在你自己的浏览器里，不会发送出去。
hero.tryon_done: 好了——打开任意抽屉，就能看到“{brand}”。
hero.tryon_cleared: 已清除——demo 会显示它们原本的名字。
hero.box_label: 全部 {count} 个 demo 的预览墙

proof.label: 这个盒子的实测数据
proof.stock: 张图库照片——所有画面都由代码绘制

box.title: 打开一个抽屉。
box.intro: 每个抽屉里，都是为一家虚构小店做的完整小网站。按行业、喜欢的风格或需要的功能筛选，然后走进去用一用。一百零八个网站，一百零八种性格。
box.note: 以下均为虚构商家的概念设计，里面的名称、价格与细节仅作示意。
box.empty_body: 少选几个条件试试——或者让盒子替你挑一个。

viewer.concept: 概念 demo · 虚构商家

services.title: 按小生意真实的运转方式来做。
services.intro: 不讲术语，不堆套餐。先想清楚你的客人需要做什么——预约、点单、打电话、找到你——再围绕它来设计。

items.title: 单页网站
items.body: 适合个体经营和刚起步的生意。客人需要的一切都在一页里：做什么、在哪、什么时候营业、怎么联系你。
items.good: 装修师傅、自由职业者、快闪店

items.title: 小生意官网
items.body: 几页精心做好的页面：服务、价格、作品、关于、联系。第一次来的人看得懂，你自己也好维护。
items.good: 诊所、美容美发、咖啡馆、工作室

items.title: 预约与咨询
items.body: 练车时段、预约、订位、报价。接入你信得过的预约工具，或者做一个直接进你邮箱的咨询流程。

items.title: 菜单、点单与小网店
items.body: 容易修改的菜单、提前点单、少量商品——接入成熟的平台，而不是自己拼凑结账系统。

items.title: 中英双语网站
items.body: 中文和英文分别为各自的读者来写，而不是机器翻译。阿拉伯语等从右到左的语言也可以。
items.good: 服务不止一个社群的生意

items.title: 上线后的照顾
items.body: 域名和主机注册在你名下，需要时帮你做小改动，再附一份看得懂的说明，基础内容你自己也能改。
items.good: 所有更想专心做生意的人

services.more: 了解全部服务：网站、App 与业务工具

process.title: 从一次聊天到网站上线，四步。

steps.title: 聊聊你的生意
steps.body: 打个电话、发封邮件或加个微信。你做什么、客人是谁、希望他们在网站上做什么。

steps.title: 挑几个抽屉
steps.body: 把感觉对的 demo 收藏起来。这是告诉我们你喜好最快的方法，不需要懂设计术语。

steps.title: 看得见，改得动
steps.body: 我们用你真实的文字和照片来设计，然后发给你一个能在手机上点来点去的预览。哪里要改，你说。

steps.title: 上线与照顾
steps.body: 域名和主机注册在你名下，在真机上逐一检查，再教你怎么自己做简单的更新。

process.note: 工期和价格取决于需求范围——开工之前，你会先收到一份书面报价。

included.title: 不显眼的地方，也要做好。

items.title: 手机优先
items.body: 大多数客人是在手机上找到你的。每个版面都先为小屏幕设计，而不是硬塞进去。

items.title: 天生就快
items.body: 手写代码，没有建站工具的臃肿。这个盒子里的 demo 平均只有 {avg_kb} KB。

items.title: 好读，好用
items.body: 足够的对比度、键盘可操作、清楚的结构——无障碍的基本功，默认就有。

items.title: 为搜索准备好
items.body: 规范的标题、描述和页面结构，让搜索引擎看懂你的生意。没有人能保证排名，我们也不会这样承诺。

items.title: 一切归你
items.body: 域名、主机和内容都属于你。哪天想换人维护，所有东西都跟着你走。

items.title: 诚实地展示
items.body: 不编评价，不造数字。我们帮你展示真实的证据——照片、资质，以及获得许可的客户原话。

items.q: 盒子里的商家是真的吗？
items.a: 不是。每个抽屉都是为虚构商家做的概念设计，用来展示不同的风格。demo 里的名称、价格、评价和联系方式都只是示意。你的网站会围绕你真实的生意来做。

items.q: 我能要一个和某个 demo 一样的网站吗？
items.a: 可以——任何一个抽屉都可以作为起点。我们会按你的品牌、文字和照片来调整版式和风格，最后是属于你的网站，而不是一份复制品。
根据需求范围和预算单独报价。开工前书面说明交付内容、付款节点与后续费用；新增需求先确认，再开展额外工作。认真做事，实在报价。
不需要。我们只问关于你生意的简单问题。你准备好 logo（如果有）、照片、服务项目和价格，其余交给我们。

items.q: 网站以后我能自己改吗？
items.a: 如果你愿意的话。菜单或价格经常变的生意，我们会设置一个简单的修改方式；不常改的，也可以由我们帮你更新。我们会按你的情况给建议。

items.q: 不在同一个城市也能合作吗？
items.a: 可以。我们通过电话、视频、邮件和微信，服务全澳各地的生意。
可以。我们为每种语言的读者分别来写，而不是逐字翻译；也可以加其他语言。

contact.title: 说说你的生意。
contact.intro: 回答几个问题就够了。我们会把它整理成一份简短的需求单，你可以用邮件发给我们，或者复制到微信、WhatsApp、短信里。
contact.liked_empty: 还没有——在任何抽屉上点 ♥，就会出现在这里。
contact.reach_detail: 你的邮箱、电话或微信号
contact.message_placeholder: 你的客人是谁、喜欢的网站、时间要求……
contact.brief_empty: 开始填写——需求单会在这里自动生成。
contact.copied: 已复制——可以粘贴到微信、WhatsApp 或短信里。
contact.copy_failed: 无法自动复制——请手动选中需求单复制。
contact.emailed: 你的邮件程序应该已经打开，需求单已经填好。你按下发送后，我们才会收到。
contact.subject: 网站咨询——{business}
contact.channels_preview: 预览版：联系方式接通后会显示在这里。你仍然可以先复制需求单。
contact.privacy: 这个表单不会把任何内容发送或保存到服务器。在你选择发邮件或复制之前，你填写的内容只留在这个页面里。

footer.tagline: 为小生意定制网站、App 与数字工具。
footer.disclaimer: 盒子里的所有 demo 都是虚构商家的概念设计，其中的名称、价格、评价和细节仅作示意。
